summary.en: A whole system as one diagram of layer bands, built from the inside out: the focus layer around the side part, then the others from the bottom up.
summary.zh: 把整个系统画成一张分层总图，从里往外搭：先在侧边部件旁画出焦点层，再从下往上画其他层。

fits: The map of a system before one part is explained; the return to it after.
notFor: Flows over time; more than six layers.

intent.en: Give the viewer the whole map first, so every detail later has a place on it.
intent.zh: 先给观众整张地图，之后每个细节都在上面有位置。

content.en: 3–6 layers (name ≤ 14 / 8, optional note ≤ 40 / 12, 1–6 parts ≤ 14 / 6 each), which layer is the focus, an optional side part, a note on whose layering it is.
content.zh: 3–6 层（层名 ≤ 14 / 8、可选说明 ≤ 40 / 12、每层 1–6 个部件 ≤ 14 / 6）、哪一层是焦点、可选侧边部件、一条“谁的分层”注。

fits.zh: 讲某一部分之前的系统总图；讲完回到总图。

notFor.zh: 随时间的流程；超过六层。

pairs.note: next: zoom into the focus layer

en: The layering is a judgement: say whose with the dashed note.
Build the focus layer first; the viewer's eye stays where the film will zoom.
zh: 分层是一种判断：用虚线注写明是谁的。
先搭焦点层；观众的视线停在之后要放大的地方。

source.path: the source film 4.84–11.97 s; skills/filmsmith/assets/kits/blueprint-zoom/starter/components/overview.js, band.js, node.js, loop.js, line.js
